items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One time I met him in California and we played together.

ctx.x: I’ll make you a copy of it. Loren Schoenberg gave me a cassette of it years ago. He was a Tristano student. He’s the only trumpet player that I know of who went through the whole Tristano rigors.

Probably so. There were some other guys I didn’t know very well. I don’t know if they studied with Tristano or one of his students, Sal Mosca or something. I met a trumpet player recently who studied with Sal. Don was talking about changing his embouchure so he could continue to play for a long time. That was the last promise that he made then he married this lady, Adora was her name, and moved to California and I hardly . . . One time I met him in California and we played together. We sounded good. That was the…
He kept a pretty low profile for about forty years or something.
